verdict.rationale: Driving a UI framework through a documented programmatic API is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party documentation of such an API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The CLI (sv create/add/check) and the MCP server are separate capabilities that do not transfer to this story. One community comment about importing the compiler is anecdotal and does not show a documented public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
